MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT — Meridian Freight & Last-Mile and Kellerman Industrial (CLI-0042).
Effective 2023-11-14. Referenced contract: CON-0042-01.
1. SERVICES. Meridian shall provide LTL logistics services in the IL region.
2. SERVICE LEVELS. Target on-time delivery of 97.0% measured monthly.
3. CREDITS. 1.0% of monthly spend credited per full percentage point below the SLA on-time target, capped at 10% of monthly spend.
4. TERM. Initial term of twenty-four (24) months, auto-renewing for successive twelve (12) month terms.
Prepared by N. Brightwater (Legal).

SLA CREDIT MEMORANDUM — Master Services Agreement with Kellerman Industrial (CLI-0042), contract CON-0042-01. Effective 2025-02-05.
Pursuant to the credit clause of the MSA, Meridian acknowledges that the January 14-16 winter storm at the Chicago hub caused on-time performance to fall below the contracted target. Root event documented under incident INC-2025-00417. Meridian will apply a credit of 1.0% of January spend per full percentage point below target, capped at 10%. This memorandum does not otherwise modify the MSA.

INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR DRIVER AGREEMENT — DRV-01188. Effective 2022-06-13.
1. RELATIONSHIP. Contractor operates as an independent contractor, not an employee.
2. PERFORMANCE. Contractor shall complete assigned routes within service windows and promptly notify dispatch of any inability to perform.
3. TERMINATION FOR CAUSE. Meridian may deactivate the contractor for repeated failure to perform or failure to notify, including no-call/no-show events.
4. DISPUTE. Disputes shall first be raised with People Ops and Legal before external remedies.
